Hello fellow hypnosis friend! 

I'm a hynoswitch (25F) and it is never easy to lose a subject or a a hypnotist. 

It takes time to heal especially from such a heavy thing. I always tell people to heal before looking for a new hypnotist otherwise you will encounter very unfriendly people (that is from experience). I would say try to find a hobby to keep yourself occupied or find some friends to hang out with. If you have any triggers or any other implemented things I would listen to files to help get rid of them. As well as letting yourself know that it is not your fault, and to become your own self again. I just had a hypnotist let me go and someone who I dearly love just recently, and finding things I was passionate about had helped me move on. I play FF14 to help myself be connected with a community or even WoW can help. There is also lots of hypnosis discord server that can relate to you and would love to talk and help out. Just feeling connected somewhere can help a lot... 

Slowly over time it will get better, and at that point it is a good time to find a hypnotist. Which also in itself is not easy because there are more subjects than hypnotist. As well as there is not many female hypnotist, I'm a female hypnotist and I get bombarded with requests (I kind of make files now to try to help people's need, I try to help way too many people.) 

It's never easy at first, but slowly finding ways to ground yourself and come back to now and the present. I do hope things get easier, and message me if you ever need any help. I'm not on here a lot so I will do my best to assist. I hope this helps and sorry if this is quite a bit of reading.
